title: Astrometry.net Solve Solve Time Leaderboard
dataSources: Observatory environment (`observatory:env`), sky-quality meter (`skyquality:reading`), imaging sessions (`imaging:session`), telescope mount (`mount:status`), cloud sensor (`allsky:cloud`).
app: Backyard observatory automation — roll-off-roof/dome controller, sky-quality meter, cloud sensor, telescope mount, and astrophotography software (N.I.N.A./Ekos) — via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=astrometry:solve solve_time_sec=*
| stats sum(solve_time_sec) as total_value, avg(solve_time_sec) as avg_value by target_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks target values by total and average solve time across Astrometry.net solve events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `solve_time_sec` values for each Astrometry.net solve event and review total and average solve time by target.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total solve time.
grandmaExplanation: It estimates which target shows the biggest solve time numbers in your Astrometry.net solve data.
